payload.core_mechanism_summary: Uses 4D boolean DP to check if all cells in rectangle (x1,y1) to (x2,y2) are free, building from smaller rectangles by extending right or down.
payload.rationale: The solution iterates over all pairs of top-left and bottom-right corners, dynamically computing validity via recurrence on boundaries. This is a DP over subrectangles, most akin to 2D DP state.
